name: Get-Service
title: Inspect Windows Service Status
summary: Lists Windows services and reports whether each is running, stopped, or paused.

examples.command: Get-Service | Where-Object Status -ne 'Running' | Select-Object Status, Name, DisplayName
examples.description: Lists services that are not currently running without changing them.

permissions.notes: Most service states are visible without elevation; protected details may require it.

risk.warning: Get-Service is read-only. Do not start or stop unfamiliar services.

output_fields.name: Status
output_fields.description: Current running, stopped, or paused state.

common_errors.meaning: The service is protected or access is restricted.
